summary: Add GET /payroll/staging-comparison endpoint returning monthly brondol (loosefruit) selisih between staging and plantware per employee, with identity fields (emp_code, emp_name, gang_code, division=estate/LocCode). Reuses existing StagingComparisonService.monthlyLoosefruit() — no service refactor needed.
approach: Append one new Elysia route to payrollRoutes in backend/src/api/payroll.ts. Handler parses ?periode=YYYY-MM (default current month) and delegates to monthlyLoosefruit(). Add 1 bun:test regression case. No new service method, no new DB queries, no cross-DB joins — the service already does it all.
convergence_summary: Route returns { success, data: { rows, summary } } with all identity + selisih fields
Uses SERVER_PROFILE_2 for staging and SERVER_PROFILE_1 for prod db_ptrj (no SERVER_PROFILE_3)
Defaults to current month when periode query omitted
No regression in existing /api/staging/compare/brondol-missing or other payroll endpoints
